top_signals.title: Bloomberg This Weekend 09/13/2026
top_signals.summary:
The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Journalist & Features Writer Isabel Woodford, BMO Capital Markets Senior Economist Jennifer Lee, Delaware Sen. Chris Coons and GasBuddy Head of Petroleum Analysis Patrick De Haan.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: LDP-backed Genta Koja wins Okinawa gubernatorial election
top_signals.summary: Media reports, including by NHK, citing exit polls said Koja had bested incumbent Gov. Denny Tamaki, who had been vying for a third term.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
